name: Example - Grid customer
description: Sample profile for a customer who mandates reference-based (X-Y grid) wire numbers. Copy it in LSEENVPROFILES, rename it after the customer and adjust the values.
notes: Format Referencing (X-Y grid) is not located in the setting map yet; set it by hand in Project Properties > Drawing Format and in each drawing's Drawing Properties until LSEENVSNAPSHOT has found the line.
